'''Workers''' are WIP [[Mobs|Parasites]], that are spawned by [[Architect|Architects]] in [[Colony|Colonies]]. Their Tier placement is currently unknown.

As of now, they use the original [[Rupter|Rupter's]] Model as a placeholder.

==''Spawning''==

*Spawned by [[Architect|Architects]].
*Spawns inside the [[Parasite Biome]], with a spawnweight of 10.

==''Behavior''==
Workers are passive utility parasites, their ai is heavily unfinished but currently serves the function of building colony structures.

*Workers roam around similar to other passive mobs, but do not run away when attacked.
*Workers progress the construction of Colony buildings when nearby to an [[Colony#Generation|Incomplete Parasitic Colony Structure]] or a location where one will be placed.

===''Weaknesses''===

*Workers, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
